summary: Woodland Community Unit School District #5 strongly opposes proposals to sunset or restrict E-Rate funding, emphasizing its essential role in maintaining an equitable, secure, and modern learning environment for its 455 students. The district relies on E-Rate funding to ensure its long-term fiscal predictability and to support its ongoing operational needs, including maintaining an equitable, secure, and modern learning environment.
